results.summary: The director holds a Gold balance that starts at 0 and shows it in the status lines the HUD draws. It spawns a gold purse at the barracks, and interacting adds 100 once (bPurseTaken guard, purse destroyed, prompt empties). I did not run the game; I confirmed the call chain by reading the code only.

evidence.note: Purse spawned at node barracks in BeginPlay. The HandleInteract Purse case adds PurseGold once, guarded by bPurseTaken.
GetStatusLines adds the gold line
The HUD calls it to draw the status text
The game mode spawns the director, so the game reaches this code
The interact key calls the interactable, which calls Director->HandleInteract
Constant 100, labelled as a demo value

results.score_reason: Gold already exists, so there is little left to build. The toll payment (DD-TOLL-02) depends on it, so unblocks is high. Impact is middling because gold alone is not the milestone ending.

results.summary: No boss interactable, boss kind, boss_room placement or bandit_strings.csv loading exists in the source. EDDDemoKind has only Carving, Control, Figure, StoreroomDoor and Purse.

evidence.note: Searched the Source tree for boss, toll, bandit_boss and boss_room. There were no matches, and the enum has no boss kind.
Searched for boss_room and bandit_boss_stage_threatening_01. Nothing spawns or voices a boss.

results.score_reason: The boss is the center of the GDD boss encounter (lines 385-387). Both the toll payment and the descent depend on it, and none of it exists in the director.

results.summary: There is no toll state, no pay action and no bandit_boss_toll_paid_01 or bandit_boss_cannot_pay_01 text. Gold is only added, never spent.

evidence.note: Searched for toll, bTollPaid, cannot_pay and toll_paid. No matches. Gold is only increased in the purse case.

results.score_reason: Paying the toll is the central mechanic of the milestone. It cannot be built before the boss exists (DD-TOLL-01), and the descent depends on it. Urgency is lower because gold is ready but the boss is not.

results.summary: There is no descent interactable at node descent, no barred message, no win message and no end-of-demo state. The map nodes are built as slabs only.

evidence.note: Searched for descent, win, barred and bDemoOver. Nothing spawns or handles a descent interactable. The HUD has no win banner.

results.score_reason: Going down the descent is the win condition (GDD lines 44-45, 390), so impact is high. It is last in the dependency chain, so it cannot start yet and nothing waits on it.
